question: The length of the playing surface for Table Tennis is _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.74 m.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **playing surface **for Table Tennis is a rectangular shape with a length of** 2.74 m** and a width of **1.525 m.**
 
• The playing surface, or table, is** matte** and consistently dark in **color.**
 
• A net that is **15.25 cm tall **divides the table into two halves.
 
• Only** hardwood tables** or their derivatives are approved by the ITTF. 
 
• It is important to note that the playing surface for Table Tennis is also commonly referred to as the** Table Tennis table **or simply the Table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Table tennis** is a **racquet sport **that originated from tennis, although it differs from the game in that participants play on a **stationary table **rather than a court. 
 
• Players work in teams of two or individually, taking turns using **small rackets** to return a light, hollow ball over the** table's net** and onto the other half of the court.
 
• If they are **unable** to do so, the other team scores a point.
 
• With event categories for **men's and women's singles** as well as men's and women's teams since doubles were replaced in **2008**, table tennis has been an** Olympic sport** since **1988.**
 
• The **International Table Tennis Federation** (ITTF), established in** 1926,** is in charge of overseeing table tennis.
 
• There are presently **226 member associations** in the ITTF globally.
